blocks.text: BOSTON — Jayson Tatum scored 32 points in 30 minutes on a night the Boston Celtics set a franchise record for its lead at the end of the opening period on the way to a 131-94 win over the Dallas Mavericks on Sunday night. Derrick White added 16 points and Jordan Walsh 11 to help Boston win its sixth straight and for the 11th time in 12 games.
